description: Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks is a 3d action platformer based on the story of Mortal Kombat 2

1.0.0.description:
first version of Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks archipelago randomizer

install guide:
you need an NTSC copy (SLUS-21087) of the game and a PCSX2 version with PINE support 
simply add the apworld to your archipelago installation (0.6.7+) and you're done
you can use the options creator to generate a yaml
then you can launch the mksm client, open pcsx2 and connect to the server while you're in the main menu of the game (you can only connect while on the main menu)

you can find more info in the AP After Dark discord server in the Future game design game thread.

1.0.2.description:
Added universal tracker tab if you have it installed and now the apworld properly supports it during generation with random options

and fixed the bug that the client could not send location checks

1.2.0.description:
# Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks Archipelago 1.2.0

## What's new
* `Wu-Shi Start` is now `Portal Start`: New Game starts you in the Portal, the bridge to Wu-Shi is locked behind the new `Wu-Shi access` item
* All 8 ko-op only Red Koins are collectible in single player (60 → 68), ko-op doors only need one button
* Added `Smoke Missions` option, a check for each of Smoke's 5 missions, progress is autosaved
* Added `Lock Special Moves` option, the first special move upgrade for each move unlocks it (VS characters too)
* Added the `Final boss health pickup` item, beating Kano no longer unlocks it
* Mana regenerates faster with each mana upgrade, a full bar refills in about the same time
* The brutality room Red Koin is spawned by breaking the statues again, but you don't need to beat Reptile to start them
* The client detects saves that don't belong to your slot and leaves the game alone until you return to the main menu
* Red Koins checked from outside the game (`!collect`, release) no longer spawn
* Logic tweaks for projectile Red Koins, Baraka's arena, Smoke missions and a few Red Koins
* Added APWorld Manager update support

## Fixes
* Seeds failing to generate with some option combinations
* The client logging in when not at the main menu
* PCSX2 losing connection or stalling while playing
* DeathLink sending received deaths back out
* The client spamming the server with EXP and goal updates
* Filler EXP sometimes lost right before a loading screen
* Some collected Red Koins respawning

## Note
* 1.1.1 seeds won't work with 1.2.0, please regenerate
* Sometimes you may have to try to press new game or load a save again if the client notifies you that your save does not belong to you even if it does.

# Docs
* Updated the game guide with the new options, logic and client features
https://github.com/orizach01/Archipelago-MKSM/blob/main/worlds/mksm/docs/en_Mortal%20Kombat%20Shaolin%20Monks.md
